hypotheses.title: Operating Cash Flow Per Share Yield Convexity (TOP1000 Subindustry, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating cash flow per share measures pure realized cash generation free of accrual distortion. Evaluating cash flow yield against its own 180-day time-series history (ts_rank) combined with signed_power quadratic convexity isolates companies reaching peak cash-conversion compounding within each subindustry. Subtracting short-term 5-day price return captures oversold mean-reversion entries. Slow quarterly updates and Decay 5 compress turnover to ~12%, targeting Fitness >= 1.80 and Self-correlation <= 0.45.
confounders: Sudden non-recurring asset sales or tax refunds temporarily boosting quarterly operating cash flow
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high cash flow yields reflect capital-intensive declining legacy businesses undergoing terminal cash liquidation.

hypotheses.title: Diluted Earnings Per Share Yield Convexity (TOP1000 Subindustry, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Diluted quarterly earnings per share measures bottom-line corporate profitability across 100% of the US equity universe. Measuring the 180-day historical time-series rank of the earnings yield (actual_eps_value_quarterly / close) filters out seasonal cyclicality. Amplifying high-conviction deciles with signed_power convexity and neutralizing by subindustry extracts persistent equity value premia while holding turnover near 12%, achieving Fitness >= 1.80 and Self-correlation <= 0.45.
confounders: Aggressive non-GAAP revenue recognition and paper accounting accruals inflating net income
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during severe market recessions where low-P/E high-earnings-yield equities experience sharp negative estimate revisions.

hypotheses.title: Balance Sheet Deleveraging Momentum & Solvency (TOP1000 Subindustry, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct architectural evolution of approved alpha b2bea437 (which achieved Sharpe 1.73, Fitness 1.66, and Self-correlation 0.52). Measuring the 60-day reduction in liabilities relative to total assets (-ts_delta(liabilities / assets, 60)) identifies corporate debt reduction and balance sheet de-risking. Firms rapidly deleveraging enjoy lower borrowing costs, reduced credit default spreads, and multiple expansion, completely decorrelated (Self-corr <= 0.35) from option IV surfaces.
confounders: Distressed asset liquidations used to pay down immediate short-term obligations
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during rapid credit expansion cycles where highly levered speculative equities drastically outperform cash-conservative firms.
